checklistSpecific: Build the sales incentive plan record with quota targets by producer tier and territory
Configure the plan's commission rate table and any accelerator/decelerator rules
Set eligibility and proration rules for mid-year plan enrollment or exit
Run a test calculation for a sample producer to validate configuration accuracy
Activate the plan configuration for the current plan year

testing.expected: Plan rules and quota targets configured and validated against a test calculation

checklistGeneric: Confirm schedules are reviewed for consistency across channels
Route schedules for legal review before publishing
checklistSpecific: Define base commission rates by product line and distribution channel
Define producer-tier rate differentials (e.g., new vs. renewal business, volume tiers)
Document override rate rules for agency principals or managing general agents
Document any bonus/accelerator components tied to production milestones
Publish the finalized commission schedule to the producer compensation policy library

testing.expected: Rates documented by product line, channel, and producer tier including overrides

checklistGeneric: Confirm structures are cost-modeled before approval
Route final structure for CHRO/sales-leadership sign-off
checklistSpecific: Analyze current distribution strategy and channel profitability targets to inform structure design
Model alternative commission structures (flat rate vs. tiered vs. hybrid) against target profitability
Benchmark proposed structures against insurance-industry producer compensation survey data
Select and document the recommended structure with supporting rationale
Route the recommended structure to CHRO and sales leadership for approval

testing.expected: Structure options modeled against profitability targets with a documented recommendation

checklistGeneric: Confirm agreement terms match the approved commission schedule
Version-control each agreement upon amendment
checklistSpecific: Draft the producer compensation agreement capturing commission rates, tiers, and payment terms
Reference the applicable commission schedule and effective date in the agreement
Include termination and vesting-of-earned-commission provisions per policy
Route the drafted agreement for producer counter-signature
File the fully executed agreement in the contract repository

testing.expected: Fully executed agreement on file referencing the correct commission schedule

checklistGeneric: Confirm loaded rates match the approved commission schedule before activating
Spot-check post-load rates against source
checklistSpecific: Load the new plan-year commission rate table into the commission management system
Load producer eligibility rules and effective/termination dates for the plan year
Spot-check a sample of loaded rates against the approved commission schedule document
Confirm the system correctly applies tiered rates by production volume
Activate the loaded rate table effective the plan-year start date

testing.expected: Loaded rate table matches the approved commission schedule for the plan year

checklistGeneric: Confirm review covers each state where the producer is licensed
Retain legal sign-off with the agreement file
checklistSpecific: Route the producer compensation agreement template to legal counsel for state DOI compliance review
Confirm the agreement contains no provisions that could constitute unlawful rebating or inducement
Verify licensing and appointment status requirements are correctly referenced
Incorporate legal's requested revisions into the agreement template
Record legal counsel's sign-off before the agreement template is used for new producers

testing.expected: Legal sign-off recorded confirming state DOI and anti-rebating compliance

checklistGeneric: Confirm payment amounts reconcile to the calculation workbook before disbursing
Retain the disbursement confirmation
checklistSpecific: Load the reconciled commission payment file into the disbursement system for the scheduled pay cycle
Select EFT or check disbursement per each producer's payment preference on file
Confirm the disbursement batch total matches the reconciled commission calculation workbook
Release the disbursement batch on the defined commission payment schedule
Retain the disbursement confirmation report with the commission cycle record

testing.expected: Disbursement batch total matches the reconciled commission calculation for the cycle

checklistGeneric: Confirm agent TIN/W-9 on file before generating forms
Retain filed forms per the records retention schedule
checklistSpecific: Compile total calendar-year commission and bonus payments by independent agent/broker
Confirm each agent's W-9 name, TIN, and address match the payment records before generating forms
Generate 1099-NEC (or 1099-MISC where applicable) forms for agents meeting the IRS reporting threshold
Distribute forms to agents and file copies with the IRS by the statutory deadline
Retain a copy of each filed form in the agent tax records

testing.expected: 1099 forms generated and filed for all agents meeting the IRS reporting threshold before the statutory deadline

checklistGeneric: Confirm source policy/billing extract is for the closed period
Retain the reconciliation workpaper
checklistSpecific: Extract closed-period policy premium and billing data from the source system of record
Compare the commission statement's premium base against the policy/billing extract by producer
Identify and quantify any variance between the statement and source data
Investigate variances above the reconciliation tolerance threshold before sign-off
Sign off the reconciliation and route confirmed statements for payment processing

testing.expected: Commission statement premium base reconciles to source policy/billing data within tolerance

checklistGeneric: Confirm cost figures reconcile to the disbursed commission totals
File the report with finance's quarterly package
checklistSpecific: Compile total producer compensation cost by distribution channel for the quarter
Compare compensation cost as a percentage of written premium against the channel profitability target
Break out cost trend by producer tier to identify any outlier channels
Summarize findings and recommendations in the quarterly producer compensation cost report
Deliver the report to finance and sales leadership

testing.expected: Quarterly compensation cost by channel reported and compared to the profitability target

checklistGeneric: Confirm every discrepancy is resolved before the payment run releases
Retain resolution notes for audit
checklistSpecific: Review the list of reconciliation discrepancies flagged above tolerance for the current cycle
Investigate each discrepancy against source policy, billing, or attainment data
Correct data errors at the source and recalculate the affected commission amount
Confirm the corrected amount ties out before including it in the payment file
Document the resolution and root cause for each cleared discrepancy

testing.expected: No unresolved discrepancies remain before the commission payment run releases

checklistGeneric: Confirm attainment source data is closed for the period before validating
Sign off validation before the calculation step begins
checklistSpecific: Extract producer attainment data (written premium, retained premium, new business count) for the closed period
Reconcile attainment totals against the policy administration system of record
Confirm attainment is correctly attributed to the writing producer, not a servicing producer
Flag any attainment records with missing or duplicate policy references for correction
Sign off that attainment data is validated and ready for commission calculation

testing.expected: Attainment data reconciled to the policy system of record and signed off before calculation

checklistGeneric: Confirm elections are processed within the plan's election window
Reconcile plan balances to the recordkeeper statement
checklistSpecific: Process participant deferral elections received during the annual enrollment window
Process investment reallocation requests within the plan's permitted change frequency
Process distribution requests per the participant's elected payment schedule and plan terms
Reconcile plan participant balances against the third-party recordkeeper's statement each quarter
Update the deferred compensation plan register with all processed transactions

testing.expected: Quarterly participant balances reconcile to the recordkeeper statement

checklistGeneric: Confirm grant records match the approved grant list before updating
Retain vesting schedule documentation per grant
checklistSpecific: Record each new LTIP grant (award type, units, grant date, vesting schedule) in the equity administration system
Update the vesting schedule tracker as tranches vest each period
Track performance-condition achievement status for performance-vesting awards
Process forfeitures for participants who terminate before vesting per plan terms
Reconcile the equity administration system's outstanding grant balance against the plan share reserve

testing.expected: Outstanding grant balance reconciles to the plan share reserve each period

checklistGeneric: Confirm the achievement calculation uses certified performance results
Have a second reviewer check the payout calculation
checklistSpecific: Pull the certified performance results for the completed performance period
Apply the plan's achievement-to-payout curve to determine the earned percentage of target units
Calculate the number of shares/units earned per participant based on achievement percentage
Cross-check a sample calculation against the plan document formula
Route the calculated payout to the compensation committee approval package

testing.expected: Earned units calculated from certified results using the plan's approved payout curve

checklistGeneric: Confirm grant data sent to the administrator matches the approved grant list
Confirm participant communications are sent after grant processing confirms
checklistSpecific: Submit the approved grant list (participant, award type, units, grant date) to the stock plan administrator
Confirm the administrator's grant confirmation matches the submitted list before closing the batch
Coordinate the participant grant notification and acceptance communication timing with the administrator
Verify grant records appear correctly in the employee equity self-service portal
Reconcile the administrator's grant confirmation against the internal equity administration system

testing.expected: Administrator grant confirmation reconciles to the internally approved grant list

checklistGeneric: Confirm each design element is checked against the applicable statutory section
Document compliance sign-off with the design record
checklistSpecific: Review each executive compensation design element against Section 409A deferral and distribution timing rules
Confirm any performance-based awards are structured for intended tax treatment under current law
Review the say-on-pay vote history and ISS/Glass Lewis guidance for design implications
Confirm proxy disclosure requirements (CD&A, summary compensation table) are reflected in plan design decisions
Record legal counsel's compliance sign-off on the finalized design

testing.expected: Legal sign-off recorded confirming 409A and disclosure-rule compliance

checklistGeneric: Confirm peer group and survey data used are current
Reconcile scenario totals to the tally sheet
checklistSpecific: Build the executive total compensation tally sheet showing base, STI, and LTI by scenario
Model pay outcomes at threshold, target, and maximum performance for the short- and long-term incentive components
Benchmark each scenario against the compensation peer group's total compensation mix
Stress-test the maximum scenario against the say-on-pay-sensitive pay ratio metrics
Deliver the scenario model to the Compensation & Benefits Manager for committee preparation

testing.expected: Threshold/target/maximum scenarios modeled and benchmarked against the peer group

checklistGeneric: Confirm figures tie to the general ledger and payroll records before drafting
Route the draft through external counsel review
checklistSpecific: Compile the summary compensation table figures (salary, bonus, stock awards, non-equity incentive, pension, other comp) for each NEO
Draft the Compensation Discussion and Analysis narrative explaining pay decisions and performance linkage
Reconcile disclosed dollar figures against payroll and equity administration system records
Route the draft disclosure sections to external securities counsel for review
Incorporate counsel's comments and finalize the sections for proxy filing

testing.expected: Summary compensation table figures reconcile to payroll and equity administration records

checklistGeneric: Confirm total cost figures reconcile to the general ledger
File the report with the board record
checklistSpecific: Compile total executive compensation cost across base, STI, LTI, and deferred compensation for the fiscal year
Reconcile the compiled total against the general ledger executive compensation expense accounts
Compare total cost against the prior year and the approved compensation budget
Summarize cost drivers (new grants, vesting events, performance payouts) in the annual report
Deliver the report to the CFO and board for the annual review

testing.expected: Reported total cost reconciles to the general ledger executive compensation accounts

checklistGeneric: Confirm ownership values use the current stock price as of the measurement date
Retain the compliance report with the committee record
checklistSpecific: Pull each executive's current vested and unvested equity holdings from the equity administration system
Calculate each executive's ownership value using the stock price as of the measurement date
Compare each executive's ownership value against their applicable multiple-of-salary guideline
Flag any executive below the guideline and note their remaining time to comply
Deliver the ownership compliance report to the compensation committee

testing.expected: Every covered executive's ownership status assessed against their guideline multiple

checklistGeneric: Confirm responses are reviewed by legal before submission
Retain the correspondence with the say-on-pay cycle record
checklistSpecific: Log the inquiry received from the proxy advisory firm (ISS/Glass Lewis) with its due date
Compile supporting data addressing the specific pay-practice question raised
Draft the response referencing the relevant proxy disclosure sections
Route the draft response through legal counsel before submission
Submit the response by the advisory firm's stated deadline and file a copy

testing.expected: Response submitted by the stated deadline with legal review recorded

checklistGeneric: Confirm peer group data is current before presenting
File committee decisions with the compensation record
checklistSpecific: Compile the CEO and NEO peer group total compensation benchmarking analysis
Prepare the pay recommendation package with base, STI target, and LTI grant value for each NEO
Present the benchmarking analysis and recommendations to the compensation committee
Capture the committee's final pay decisions for each NEO in the meeting record
Communicate the committee's approved pay decisions to payroll and equity administration for processing

testing.expected: Committee's final pay decisions recorded for each NEO with peer benchmarking on file

checklistGeneric: Confirm holdings data is refreshed each reporting period
Escalate persistent non-compliance to CHRO
checklistSpecific: Update each covered executive's vested and unvested holdings from the equity administration system each quarter
Recalculate ownership value against the applicable multiple-of-salary guideline using the current stock price
Track each executive's compliance trend (improving, static, declining) over the guideline compliance period
Flag executives who remain non-compliant past their allotted compliance period
Escalate persistent non-compliance cases to CHRO for follow-up

testing.expected: Quarterly compliance status tracked for every covered executive with escalation for persistent non-compliance
